summary: Eight days in France: Paris, TGV to Lyon, gastronomy and traboules, then back to Paris and an early morning flight — paced for a city break with one regional hop.

days.title: Arrival in Paris and a light evening walk
days.travelHack: On arrival at CDG, take RER B to the center (~30–40 min). A hotel in the Marais makes the first evening easy on foot.
days.transportationTips: RER B to the center ~30–40 min (€11.40). Explore the Marais on foot; metro for longer distances.
days.localWarnings: After a late arrival, don't force major sights.

afternoon.name: Arrival at CDG and transfer to hotel
afternoon.description: Land, collect luggage, and transfer to Paris.
bullets: Allow 45–90 min to the hotel, depending on traffic.
RER B or taxi — choose based on luggage and time.

afternoon.name: Check-in and short break
afternoon.description: Settle in and freshen up after the flight.
bullets: Refresh for 45–90 min.
Save major sights for tomorrow — keep the evening light.

evening.name: Short walk through Le Marais
evening.description: Light intro to Paris — squares and streets, no long program.
bullets: Place des Vosges, if you're up for it.
Dinner: see recommendation below.

evening.name: Dinner: Chez Janou (Marais)
evening.description: We recommend Chez Janou — a Provençal bistro with legendary chocolate mousse.
bullets: An evening reservation makes sense.
Quicker alternative: L'As du Fallafel (Rue des Rosiers).

days.title: Paris icons
days.travelHack: Buy Eiffel Tower tickets online — a morning slot means shorter lines.
days.transportationTips: Metro: carnet or day/multi-day pass. Uber/Bolt as needed.

morning.name: Eiffel Tower
morning.description: Classic morning visit — less crowding, better views.
bullets: Book tickets in advance.
Photo from Trocadéro before or after the ascent.

afternoon.name: Lunch: Café Marly (Louvre)
afternoon.description: We recommend Café Marly — pyramid views and set menus for a calm lunch break.
bullets: Reserve the terrace if the weather is nice.
Quicker alternative: Angelina (Rue de Rivoli) for hot chocolate + quiche.

afternoon.name: Walk around the Louvre and Tuileries
afternoon.description: Outer courtyard and gardens — save the full museum for another time if you don't have a reservation.
bullets: Pyramid and gardens are worth it even without going inside.
Metro to the Seine for an evening cruise.

evening.name: Seine cruise
evening.description: Sunset cruise — day and night views of the city.
bullets: Departures are frequent from several points along the river.
Audio guide in multiple languages.

evening.name: Dinner: Bouillon Chartier
evening.description: We recommend Bouillon Chartier — classic Paris brasserie, good value for the white-tiled dining room.
bullets: The queue is part of the experience — arrive early or wait.
Alternative closer to the Seine: Les Deux Magots (pricier, more touristy).

days.title: TGV to Lyon and Vieux Lyon
days.travelHack: TGV from Gare de Lyon to Part-Dieu takes approximately 2 hours — book seats in advance.
days.transportationTips: TGV Paris→Lyon approximately 2 hours. In Lyon: TCL (metro, tram, bus); single ticket ~€2.

morning.name: High-speed TGV to Lyon
morning.description: TGV from Paris Gare de Lyon to Lyon Part-Dieu through the French countryside.
bullets: Arrive at the station 20–30 min early.
The journey takes approximately 2 hours.

afternoon.name: Check-in in Lyon
afternoon.description: Local transfer to the hotel, check-in, and drop bags.
bullets: Part-Dieu → hotel by metro or tram.

afternoon.name: Lunch: Le Bouchon des Cordeliers
afternoon.description: We recommend Le Bouchon des Cordeliers — classic Lyonnaise cuisine on the Presqu'île.
bullets: Order quenelle de brochet or salade Lyonnaise.
Alternative: Chez Paul (Rue de la République).

afternoon.name: Vieux Lyon (old town)
afternoon.description: Saint-Jean Cathedral, hidden traboules, and craft streets.
bullets: Find at least one traboule between buildings.
Calmer pace — Fourvière is tomorrow.

evening.name: Dinner: Café Comptoir Abel
evening.description: We recommend Café Comptoir Abel — one of the best-known bouchons in Vieux Lyon.
bullets: Reservation almost essential on weekends.
Alternative: Daniel et Denise (also a classic).

days.title: Fourvière and gastronomy
days.travelHack: Take the funicular up to Fourvière — walk back down or ride again.
days.transportationTips: Fourvière funicular back to Vieux Lyon. Les Halles Paul Bocuse: metro B (Part-Dieu / Brotteaux).

morning.name: Basilica Notre-Dame de Fourvière
morning.description: City views and the nearby Roman amphitheater.
bullets: Basilica entry is free.
Photograph the panorama before lunch.

afternoon.name: Lunch: Les Halles Paul Bocuse
afternoon.description: We recommend Les Halles Paul Bocuse — oysters at the stalls, cheeses and charcuterie under one roof.
bullets: Start at Giraudet or Chez Léa — then cheese + a glass of wine.
Don't rush: this is the city's gastronomic hub.

evening.name: Dinner: Le Café des Fédérations
evening.description: We recommend Le Café des Fédérations — lively bouchon where locals eat.
bullets: Reserve a table — the place is small.
Alternative: Le Bouchon des Filles (slightly more modern).

days.title: Art, silk and traboules
days.travelHack: Croix-Rousse is on a hill — metro C saves your legs, then walk the passageways.
days.transportationTips: Museum → Croix-Rousse: pleasant walk or short metro. Walking is best on the hill.

morning.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon
morning.description: Renoir, Monet, Picasso, Rubens — a calm morning museum.
bullets: Inner courtyard and gardens are worth a pause.
Allow 2–3 hours.

afternoon.name: Lunch: Le Canut et Les Gones
afternoon.description: We recommend Le Canut et Les Gones — local bouchon in the heart of Croix-Rousse.
bullets: Terrace if available — otherwise the interior is just as good.
Alternative: La Cuisinerie (more contemporary).

afternoon.name: Croix-Rousse and silk workshops
afternoon.description: Silk heritage, traboules, and Mur des Canuts.
bullets: Visit a workshop or the Canuts mural.
Walk through hidden passageways on foot.

evening.name: Dinner: Les Apothicaires
evening.description: We recommend Les Apothicaires — contemporary Lyonnaise cuisine, one dinner is enough.
bullets: Book ahead — small restaurant.
Alternative: Le Petit Bouchon (more classic).

days.title: Park, museum and farewell dinner
days.travelHack: Tête d'Or in the morning, Confluence in the afternoon — logical direction south on the Presqu'île.
days.transportationTips: Tête d'Or: tram T1/T4. Confluence: T1/T2 or river shuttle.

morning.name: Parc de la Tête d'Or
morning.description: Free zoo, botanical garden, and roses — easy morning pace.
bullets: Boat on the lake is seasonal.
Picnic if the weather cooperates.

afternoon.name: Lunch: Chez Hugon
afternoon.description: We recommend Chez Hugon — traditional bouchon (saucisson, tablier de sapeur).
bullets: Beaujolais or Côtes du Rhône alongside.
Alternative: Le Garet (also a classic).

afternoon.name: Musée des Confluences
afternoon.description: Evolution, science, and cultures in a futuristic building.
bullets: Panorama from the site at the southern tip of the Presqu'île.
Allow 1.5–2 hours.

evening.name: Dinner: Brasserie Georges
evening.description: We recommend Brasserie Georges — grand art-deco brasserie for a farewell dinner.
bullets: Reserve a table — Saturday can be full.
Alternative (fine dining): Le Neuvième Art.

days.title: Return to Paris and a quiet evening
days.travelHack: For tomorrow's 06:00 flight, choose a hotel closer to CDG or pre-book a morning taxi — don't count on the first RER.
days.transportationTips: TGV Lyon→Paris approximately 2 hours. On arrival at Gare de Lyon: metro or RER to the hotel.
days.localWarnings: Early morning flight — wrap up the evening on time.

morning.name: High-speed TGV back to Paris
morning.description: Morning TGV from Lyon Part-Dieu to Paris Gare de Lyon.
bullets: The journey takes approximately 2 hours.
Keep luggage ready for a quick transfer.

afternoon.name: Check-in at Paris hotel
afternoon.description: Settle in — ideally closer to CDG or with a reliable morning taxi.
bullets: For a 06:00 flight, don't count on the first morning train.
Book taxi/Uber the evening before.

afternoon.name: Saint-Germain-des-Prés
afternoon.description: Coffee in a literary café, bookshops, and a calm walk.
bullets: Coffee: Café de Flore or Les Deux Magots — classic Saint-Germain experience.
Metro connections are good if you stay in the center.

evening.name: Dinner: Le Procope
evening.description: We recommend Le Procope — an early farewell dinner before the 06:00 flight.
bullets: Early slot (18:30–19:30) — you're up early tomorrow.
Quicker alternative: Bouillon République.

days.title: Departure from Paris
days.travelHack: For an international flight at 06:00, be at CDG around 03:00 — pre-booked taxi/Uber only.
days.transportationTips: For an early morning flight from CDG, pre-book taxi or Uber/Bolt the evening before. Arrive ~3 hours before an international flight.
days.localWarnings: Public transport at this hour isn't reliable for check-in — don't count on the first RER.

morning.name: Transfer to CDG and international departure
morning.description: Pre-booked taxi to the airport and departure.
bullets: Leave the hotel around 02:45–03:15.
Arrive ~3 hours before an international flight.
